lyrics.ja: 僕らが見ている太陽って
lyrics.romaji: Bokura ga Mite Iru Taiyou tte
lyrics.en: The sun we're looking at

lyrics.ja: 8分も前の景色で
lyrics.romaji: Happun mo Mae no Keshiki de
lyrics.en: Is a scene from eight whole minutes ago
lyrics.zh: 其實是八分鐘前的景象

lyrics.ja: 実はちょっと昔らしい
lyrics.en: Apparently, it's actually a little in the past
lyrics.zh: 據說其實是稍早的過去

lyrics.ja: そう考えると不思議かもね
lyrics.romaji: Sou Kangaeru to Fushigi Kamo ne
lyrics.en: When you think about it, it's kind of mysterious, isn't it?
lyrics.zh: 這麼一想，或許很不可思議呢

lyrics.ja: そこにあるようでいて
lyrics.romaji: Soko ni Aru You de Ite
lyrics.en: It seems to be right there

lyrics.ja: 少しズレた時間を過ごしてる
lyrics.en: But it's living in a slightly shifted time
lyrics.zh: 卻度過著稍微錯位的時間

lyrics.ja: きっと僕らの遠い先祖
lyrics.en: Surely our distant ancestors

lyrics.ja: 隣の人のことを
lyrics.romaji: Tonari no Hito no Koto wo
lyrics.en: Knew nothing at all

lyrics.ja: 一つも知らないけど
lyrics.en: About the person next to them

lyrics.ja: 分かんないまんま東へ向かった
lyrics.en: Yet they still headed east without understanding
lyrics.zh: 卻在什麼都不懂的情況下朝東方前進

lyrics.ja: アマテラテラス　この手で触れて
lyrics.en: Amateraterasu—touch it with these hands
lyrics.zh: 天照太陽，用這雙手觸碰

lyrics.ja: 輪になって踊りましょ
lyrics.en: Let's form a circle and dance

lyrics.ja: アマテラテラス　聴かせて
lyrics.en: Amateraterasu—let me hear it

lyrics.ja: あのね　君だって歌えるよ
lyrics.romaji: Ano ne Kimi Datte Utaeru yo
lyrics.en: You know, you can sing too
lyrics.zh: 聽我說，你也可以歌唱喔

lyrics.ja: 誰にだって降り注いだ
lyrics.en: The light from eight minutes ago
lyrics.zh: 曾灑落在每個人身上的

lyrics.ja: 8分前の光が差す方へ
lyrics.romaji: Happun Mae no Hikari ga Sasu Hou e
lyrics.en: Pours down on everyone—toward where it shines
lyrics.zh: 八分鐘前的光芒，朝它照耀的方向

lyrics.ja: 僕らは分かり合えない
lyrics.en: We can't understand each other

lyrics.ja: お互いの世界には
lyrics.en: In each other's worlds

lyrics.ja: 誰も価値を付けられない
lyrics.en: No one can put a value on it

lyrics.ja: それでも隣で生きていたい
lyrics.romaji: Sore demo Tonari de Ikite Itai
lyrics.en: Even so, I want to live beside you
lyrics.zh: 即使如此，還是想在你身旁活下去

lyrics.ja: こんなに狭い星だから
lyrics.en: Because this planet is so small
lyrics.zh: 因為這顆星球如此狹小

lyrics.ja: 肩でも組んでさ　歌いましょ
lyrics.en: Let's put our arms around each other and sing

lyrics.ja: ずっと独りぼっちはもう最後
lyrics.en: Being alone forever ends here
lyrics.zh: 永遠孤單一人，到此為止

lyrics.ja: 岩のように厚い雲を
lyrics.romaji: Iwa no You ni Atsui Kumo wo
lyrics.en: Through clouds as thick as rock

lyrics.ja: こそりと覗いた手を
lyrics.en: A hand that secretly peeked through

lyrics.ja: 握って掴んで引っ張り出して
lyrics.en: Hold it, grab it, and pull it out

lyrics.ja: 数多(あまた)を照らす光は
lyrics.en: The light that shines on so many

lyrics.ja: 寂(さみ)しい記憶も同じように
lyrics.romaji: Samishii Kioku mo Onaji You ni
lyrics.en: Just the same, it illuminates lonely memories too
lyrics.zh: 也同樣照亮寂寞的記憶

lyrics.ja: 余さず照らし出すから
lyrics.en: Without missing anything

lyrics.ja: 背中向けないで進むだけ
lyrics.en: So don't turn your back—just keep moving forward
lyrics.zh: 只要不轉過身，繼續前進就好

lyrics.ja: アマテラテラス　この手で触れて
lyrics.en: Amateraterasu—touch it with these hands
lyrics.zh: 天照太陽，用這雙手觸碰

lyrics.ja: 輪になって踊りましょ
lyrics.en: Let's form a circle and dance

lyrics.ja: アマテラテラス　聴かせて
lyrics.en: Amateraterasu—let me hear it

lyrics.ja: あのね　君だって歌えるよ
lyrics.romaji: Ano ne Kimi Datte Utaeru yo
lyrics.en: You know, you can sing too
lyrics.zh: 聽我說，你也可以歌唱喔

lyrics.ja: 世界中のどんな朝も
lyrics.en: Every morning around the world

lyrics.ja: 8分前の光に満ちている
lyrics.romaji: Happun Mae no Hikari ni Michite Iru
lyrics.en: Is filled with light from eight minutes ago
lyrics.zh: 都充滿著八分鐘前的光芒
